lines.zh: 我还没学会在冰上站稳。
lines.en: I haven't learned to stand on ice.
A penguin chick's belly against the ice.

lines.zh: 我摇着两只短翅膀走路。
lines.en: I waddle along, swinging my short flippers.
The ice is slick, so I walk around it.
We walk in a line, and I'm at the back.
I've trodden this stretch of ice many times.
Fish in the ice crack — I can smell them.
I waddle, and I'm quite steady.
Wet down gets heavy; I can't walk fast.
How far across this ice?
The snowbank is hard climbing; I shuffle up.
Flippers for feet — a slip with every step.
The ice is thin; I test each step first.

lines.zh: 石头挡住路，我翻不上去。
lines.en: A rock blocks me, and I can't climb it.

lines.zh: 冰面上的小短腿，走一步滑一步。
lines.en: Short legs on ice: a slip with every step.
Penguin steps — short, but never stopping.
I'm thinking about something very big.
Snow lands on my beak. I stay still.
I'll just stand here a while.
Stand still long enough and I doze off.

lines.zh: 我站在冰上，等大人回来。
lines.en: On the ice, I wait for the grown ones.

lines.zh: 冰原上没草，我还是闻了闻。
lines.en: No grass on this ice, but I sniff anyway.
Feet together, tail pressed to the ice.

lines.zh: 我在等大人们从海里回来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the grown ones to come back from the sea.

lines.zh: 我还没长齐羽毛，走不稳。
lines.en: My feathers aren't in — I waddle.
Belly on the ice — nicely cool.
I'm waiting for mother to bring back a fish.

lines.zh: 雪地里我站一会儿，就冻住了。
lines.en: A moment in the snow and I freeze stiff.
The wind's too strong, so I ball up.
That fish from before — where did it go?

lines.zh: 我盯着冰面发了好久的呆。
lines.en: I've stared at the ice for ages.

lines.zh: 我还没长齐羽，走起来晃。
lines.en: My feathers aren't in yet, so I waddle.
You're too far away. I can't see you clearly.
I cannot swim yet. I only follow.
Your boot is taller than I am.
You again, watching me from the ice edge.

lines.zh: 你手里是鱼吗？给我看看。
lines.en: Is that a fish in your hand? Let me see.

lines.zh: 绒毛还没换，风一吹就抖。
lines.en: Still in down; one gust and I shiver.

lines.zh: 我还不会游，只会跟着走。
lines.en: I cannot swim yet; I can only follow.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，还带着寒气。
lines.en: You smell of iron and cold.

lines.zh: 我还没学会游，先学站稳。
lines.en: I haven't learned to swim; first, standing.
You keep staring. I'm a little scared.
Kneel down and I can reach you.

lines.zh: 我绒毛还没换，走路打滑。
lines.en: My down hasn't moulted; I slip walking.
My down is wet — let me shake it out.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛挡住了，还是疼。
lines.en: My down cushioned it, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我缩在雪堆后面，等着长大。
lines.en: I huddle behind a snowdrift, waiting to grow.
I've curled up into a ball like an egg.
My call has shrunk to chirps.
This is nothing, really.
I want to squeeze back to my parents' feet.
I tuck my flippers under my belly.
It hurts, but I won't cry.

lines.zh: 我踩在薄冰上，滑了个跟头。
lines.en: I slipped on thin ice and tumbled.
That dried fish — is it for me?
Hold that out and I will follow you.
You've got fish. I'll follow you.
Stop waving it. My little legs can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我在冰上走两步，就滑一下。
lines.en: Two steps on the ice and I slip once.
Do not hold it so high; my flippers are short.
I can't call yet. I'll just follow.
One more small fish and I'm full.

lines.zh: 鱼味钻进鼻孔，我走不动。
lines.en: Fish-smell fills my nose, and my feet won't move.
Fish! I'm hopping over!

lines.zh: 我还没换羽，只能挨着走。
lines.en: Not yet fledged, I can only waddle.
That smell is like the sea, but not quite.

lines.zh: 这味道，让我的腿有点软。
lines.en: This smell makes my legs a little weak.

lines.zh: 我绒毛还没换成防水羽。
lines.en: My down has not turned to waterproof feathers.
My down has not changed yet; I waddle.

lines.zh: 冰水里的鱼，我早就闻到了。
lines.en: Fish under the ice — I smelled them long ago.
Those are flippers, not hooves.
My flipper slipped and I bumped into your boot.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你一抬脚就过。
lines.en: I'm this short. Just step over me.

lines.zh: 你的鞋压住我的尾羽了。
lines.en: Your boot is pressing on my tail feathers.
Belly up, I flap twice.
You bumped my down all puffy.
Harder than the ice underfoot.

lines.zh: 你撞得我歪到一边去了。
lines.en: You knocked me right off balance.
My down is soft. The bump didn't hurt.

lines.zh: 我毛还软，挤在大人中间。
lines.en: My down is soft; I crowd between the adults.

lines.zh: 我把肚皮贴着你的肚皮。
lines.en: I press my belly against yours.
Two little heads pressed together.
Your feathers are shinier than mine.
Give me your flipper. Let's block the wind together.
I press against your leg for warmth.

lines.zh: 这块冰，只容得下我们俩。
lines.en: This patch of ice only fits the two of us.
This snowfield is ours.
I can't swim yet. Don't push.

lines.zh: 我们的崽，会先学会站稳。
lines.en: Our chick will learn to stand first.
On the stone shore, I stand by your boots.
I drag this fish into the snowbank.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼着，走一步晃一步。
lines.en: I hold it in my beak, wobbling along.
Whatever I find on the ice is mine.

lines.zh: 这鱼掉在雪上，我拖回来。
lines.en: The fish dropped on the snow; I drag it back.
I hide by my parents' feet.

lines.zh: 我还不会游，先在岸上摇。
lines.en: I can't swim yet. I'll waddle ashore.
This ice shard is blindingly bright.
This thing won't budge under my beak.
I'll hide it and eat it when I'm bigger.
Carrying it tires me, so I set it down.
Wobbly as I am, I still bump you.

lines.zh: 雪地里的小个子，别小看。
lines.en: The little one in the snow is not to be dismissed.
I can't swim on my own yet.
I spread my short flippers to block you.

lines.zh: 目标：那个偷我雪地草的。
lines.en: Target: the one stealing my snow grass.
You stole my fish. I'll chase you down.
Legs this short do not charge fast.
I'm this small. Can I even charge?
That tender shoot; I saw it first.
Wobbling or not, here I come.

lines.zh: 冰上滑，我走一步算一步。
lines.en: The ice is slick. One careful step at a time.
The ice is slick, but I keep coming.
I still have my baby down.

lines.zh: 这片冰我天天走，你别想溜。
lines.en: I walk this ice daily. You won't slip away.

lines.zh: 你的热气，在冰上化出痕迹。
lines.en: Your warmth leaves a trail on the ice.
My little legs trip when I run.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰面追，你别拐弯。
lines.en: I hug the ice chasing you. Don't turn.
My flippers are rubbed raw. Wait for me.

lines.zh: 我肚子贴地滑，追得上你。
lines.en: Belly to the ice, I can still catch you.

lines.zh: 追完你，我要回冰上歇着。
lines.en: After this chase I'm resting on the ice.
I ram my head into your shin.
Hit so hard I spun twice.
Step back and I'll stop pecking.
My beak is small, but it stings.
I bump you with my belly. Don't cry.
Phew, I used too much force.
Done fighting. I want fish.
My flipper swung and missed.
This bump is for my flock.
Even a penguin chick pecks.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里爬出来，脚一软。
lines.en: I climb out of the shell and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 我这么小，就站在这群中间。
lines.en: So small, and I stand in the middle of the flock.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛还没换成防水羽毛。
lines.en: My down hasn't turned to waterproof feathers yet.
I haven't learned to stand steady.

lines.zh: 冰面上没有雪，我不习惯。
lines.en: Bare ice. I'm not used to this.

lines.zh: 冰风扑面，我打了个哆嗦。
lines.en: Icy wind hits my face, and I shiver.
Is this woods?
Find the grown ones first, then learn to walk.
I'm Baby Penguin. Nice to meet you.
The ice underfoot is just cold enough.
If my down catches fire, I can't run.
That stumble on the ice was my own fault.

lines.zh: 我还没学会游，往下沉了。
lines.en: I can't swim yet, and I'm sinking.
The blast threw me onto a snowbank.
An arrow sticks at the base of my flipper.

lines.zh: 咒语穿过我软软的骨头。
lines.en: The spell runs through my soft little bones.
I can't fish for myself yet.
Thunder struck and my down stood on end.
Falling into the void, there is not even wind.
